say:2:1321747001:1.text: Captain Rodrigo, Lieutenant, you truly are the finest knights in Whiteridge! Solving Miss Lydia's intricate puzzle so fast is quite impressive.
say:2:1321747001:1.source_cn: 罗德里戈大人，副官大人，你们真不愧是白山公国最优秀的骑...

say:3:1321747002:1.text: Please hand me your collection card, and I shall paint the petals.
say:3:1321747002:1.source_cn: 请将收集卡交给我，让我为你们的花瓣涂上颜色吧！
say:3:1321747002:1.male: Please hand me your collection card, and I shall paint the petals.
say:3:1321747002:1.female: Please hand me your collection card, and I shall paint the petals.

say:5:1321747003:1.text: Yes. The real, first-place sapphirine petals were prepared specifically for the princess.
say:5:1321747003:1.source_cn: 嗯，给第一名的真正花瓣是为公主殿下准备的。
say:5:1321747003:1.male: Yes. The real, first-place sapphirine petals were prepared specifically for the princess.
say:5:1321747003:1.female: Yes. The real, first-place sapphirine petals were prepared specifically for the princess.

say:7:1321747008:1.text: I believe she should be in the <style="highlight">atelier</style>. I saw her heading that way. The attendants prepared an activity there for her.

say:8:1321747009:1.text: If you head over now, you might run into her!
say:8:1321747009:1.source_cn: 你们现在过去的话，说不定还能碰到殿下哦！

say:11:1321747010:1.text: Run into... an alive Yolena? Just the thought gives Chippy goosebumps!
say:11:1321747010:1.source_cn: 再、再碰到活蹦乱跳的公主殿下吗……光是想象，满满的毛都...

say:12:1321747011:1.text: ...Regardless, our priority is to locate the princess.
say:12:1321747011:1.source_cn: 就算是那样……也得先找到公主殿下。

say:14:1321747004:1.text: In terms of speed, you were indeed the fastest.
say:14:1321747004:1.source_cn: 从解谜的速度来说，你们当然是最快的。
say:14:1321747004:1.male: In terms of speed, you were indeed the fastest.
say:14:1321747004:1.female: In terms of speed, you were indeed the fastest.

say:15:1321747005:1.text: However, the true intent of this celebration is to cheer up the princess. Therefore, the first-place sapphirine petals are intended for her.
say:15:1321747005:1.source_cn: 不过你们也知道，这场庆典的目的其实是哄公主殿下高兴，所...
say:15:1321747005:1.male: However, the true intent of this celebration is to cheer up the princess. Therefore, the first-place sapphirine petals are intended for her.
say:15:1321747005:1.female: However, the true intent of this celebration is to cheer up the princess. Therefore, the first-place sapphirine petals are intended for her.

choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 我们竟然不是表现得最好的？

say:16:1321747006:1.source_cn: 这可不行。第一名的花瓣是为公主殿下准备的。
